objective: Turn individual listening history into retention, identity expression and organic distribution.
businessContext: The product accumulates personally meaningful behavioral data throughout the year.
strategy: Package first-party usage data as a personalized annual story designed for sharing.
outcomes: Wrapped became a recurring product-marketing moment with widespread user sharing.
whatWorked: The value comes from accumulated product use and personal identity.
Distribution is built into the experience.
whatFailed: Simplification and data interpretation can create user complaints or confusion.
transferConditions: Users have meaningful first-party history, clear consent expectations and a reason to share.
nonTransferConditions: Do not imitate the visual format when the underlying data lacks personal meaning.

sources.title: Spotify Wrapped, a Decade of Data Stories
